<section name="Conventions" source="repo" priority="1">
<document source="specs/support-agent-tms-tool-contract/contracts/get-booking-status.md" type="spec" relevance="0.53" tokens="144">
## Open Questions

- The exact UI design of the delivery card in `bowman-ui` is not yet finalized (prototype maturity: none in the approved plan). A design must be agreed and linked before the `apps/web` renderer is implemented. It has one open question of its own: an order may hold twenty shipments, so the design must say how a long card set presents — collapsed, scrolled or summarised — given that FR-102 renders every shipment and drops none. ([from plan](https://lore.gcp.re-cinq.com/repos/re-cinq/Otto/plans/b4b2026f-63ce-4f1a-80bb-7a971f01f47f#q-review-c4103095443))
</document>
</section>
<section name="Architecture Decisions" source="adrs" priority="2">
<document source="adrs/ADR-002-deterministic-delivery-status-rendering.md" type="adr" relevance="1.00" tokens="585">
## Context

PR #261 review comment 4098626654 proposed dropping the delivery card and letting the model phrase the answer in free text. The decision was settled on 2026-09-25.

Three things in this plan rest on the model **never** phrasing a delivery time: ([from plan](https://lore.gcp.re-cinq.com/repos/re-cinq/Otto/plans/b4b2026f-63ce-4f1a-80bb-7a971f01f47f#p_4c37e3b5-2d8c-45eb-88d3-dbc55c9b3a65))

1. **The card-rate KPI counts cards.** A prose answer has no measurable denominator; SC-006 (card rate ≥ 90% by 2026-Q4) can only be measured if the answer is always a card. ([from plan](https://lore.gcp.re-cinq.com/repos/re-cinq/Otto/plans/b4b2026f-63ce-4f1a-80bb-7a971f01f47f#k-delivery-eta))
2. **EU AI Act and danish-review compliance.** The data-flow record and the `docs/danish-review.md` rows promise the customer reads delivery status verbatim from the TMS. A paraphrased ETA is the one hallucination this pilot cannot afford. ([from plan](https://lore.gcp.re-cinq.com/repos/re-cinq/Otto/plans/b4b2026f-63ce-4f1a-80bb-7a971f01f47f#p_4c37e3b5-2d8c-45eb-88d3-dbc55c9b3a65))
3. **FR-043 of support-agent-tms-tools is being amended precisely to permit a deterministic-render tool.** Without the card, the amendment has no justification; the prohibition would stand. ([from plan](https://lore.gcp.re-cinq.com/repos/re-cinq/Otto/plans/b4b2026f-63ce-4f1a-80bb-7a971f01f47f#p_4c37e3b5-2d8c-45eb-88d3-dbc55c9b3a65))

The thumbs-up rate KPI (SC-007, ≥ 80% by 2026-Q4) also depends on the card always being rendered — ratings attach to card turns; a prose answer produces no rating. ([from plan](https://lore.gcp.re-cinq.com/repos/re-cinq/Otto/plans/b4b2026f-63ce-4f1a-80bb-7a971f01f47f#kpi_71c25831-220c-4f5d-ae74-6db4c0a6d55e))

## Decision

Delivery status answers are **always rendered as a deterministic card** with `suppressAssistantResponse: true`. The model never phrases a delivery time, an ETA, or a delivery status in prose. ([from plan](https://lore.gcp.re-cinq.com/repos/re-cinq/Otto/plans/b4b2026f-63ce-4f1a-80bb-7a971f01f47f#p_7b75ccc7-9e83-4505-ac6e-f13070df6b0a))

The not-found card is deterministic for the same reason: the model cannot invent a shipment it did not fetch. ([from plan](https://lore.gcp.re-cinq.com/repos/re-cinq/Otto/plans/b4b2026f-63ce-4f1a-80bb-7a971f01f47f#p_4c37e3b5-2d8c-45eb-88d3-dbc55c9b3a65))
</document>
</section>
